prompt: Wide landscape photograph at early dawn on the eastern slope of the Gaoligong Mountains in Baoshan, Yunnan. In the foreground, rows of coffee trees with glossy dark green leaves and clusters of ripening red and green coffee cherries, dew on the leaves, following the terraced contour of the hillside. In the middle distance the slope falls away into a valley filled with soft layered morning mist; forested ridgelines rise above the mist in fading blue-grey layers. Low cool light just before sunrise, a faint warm glow along the top ridge. Muted, restrained palette of deep forest green, mist grey-white and a touch of warm brown earth. Quiet, documentary, natural color, no people, no buildings, no text. Leave calm open sky and mist in the upper third for headline space.
